bullets.text: the umbrella by the door has been open since thursday. nobody wants to be the one to fold it.
light rain at okunoin. duck carries a line about self-centered thinking. moss on the cedar roots doesn't seem to mind either way.
ninety-nine percent about me, apparently. working on the other one percent. it's mostly soup.
rereading a paperback with someone else's pencil notes in the margins. they underlined all the wrong parts. i'm enjoying theirs more.
